<div class="CONTENT " data-variant="default" 	data-misc="">

	
			<div class="content" >
			<h3 class="b-h2">What used to be manageable accounting is now a constant source of risk.</h3>
		</div>
	
	
	</div>








<div class="CONTENT " data-variant="default" 	data-misc="">

	
			<div class="content" >
			<p class="b-text-large">Investment portfolios are more complex than ever — spanning complex asset classes, accounting bases, and global reporting regimes. Clearwater’s GenAI-enabled investment accounting platform is engineered to handle this complexity without added risk or overhead.</p>
		</div>
	
	
	</div>





	</div>
</div>








<div class="b-spacer " data-variant="default" data-height='medium'></div>








<div class="COLUMNS " data-variant="icon" 		data-icon-options=""
	data-misc="inview">

	<div class="b-columns   ">
					<div class="b-column" data-width="1/2">
				<div class="outer-wrapper" >
					<div class="inner-wrapper" data-inview="0">
												<div class="content">
							<p class="b-text-large"><em>Your frustration…</em></p>
<ul class="b-lines">
<li>Data is fragmented across custodians, managers, and internal systems.</li>
<li>Each accounting basis requires separate, duplicative workflows.</li>
<li>Reporting requires manual assembly and formatting.</li>
<li>Regulatory expectations shift faster than internal tools can adapt.</li>
<li>Disconnected ABOR and IBOR systems create conflicting views of the portfolio.</li>
</ul>

						
						
						</div>					</div>
									</div>
							</div>
					<div class="b-column" data-width="1/2">
				<div class="outer-wrapper" >
					<div class="inner-wrapper" data-inview="0">
												<div class="content">
							<p class="b-text-large"><em>Left unchecked…</em></p>
<ul class="b-lines">
<li>Reconciliation becomes manual, error-prone, and time-consuming.</li>
<li>Month-end close slows to a crawl, and the risk of inconsistencies grows.</li>
<li>Stakeholders lose surety when reports are delayed, restated, or difficult to audit.</li>
<li>You miss compliance updates, increasing audit exposure and risk of penalties.</li>
<li>Decisions are made using inconsistent data, leading to performance reporting errors, compliance breaches, and operational inefficiencies.</li>
</ul>

						
						
						</div>					</div>
									</div>
							</div>
			</div>
</div>
